amp> c, a, t, o, b = population 8
c: 8 members, c{1..8}, all individuals
a: 8 members, a{1..8}, all individuals
t: 8 members, t{1..8}, all individuals
o: 8 members, o{1..8}, all individuals
b: 8 members, b{1..8}, all individuals
amp> cat = <c -> a -> t>
cat: <c, a, t> and transition c -> a -> t
amp> ca = <cat{c, a}>
ca: <cat{c, a}>
amp> inspect ca
ca: #3 <c{1}, a{1}>
amp> at = cat{a, t}
at: transition cat{a, t}
amp> inspect at
at: #4 transition a{1} -> t{1}
amp> compare ca, cat
ca ∩ cat   c, a (2)
ca ∪ cat   c, a, t (3)
ca − cat   ∅ (0)
cat − ca   t (1)
ca △ cat   t (1)
ca ⊆ cat   yes
cat ⊆ ca   no
amp> cot = <c -> o -> t>
cot: <c, o, t> and transition c -> o -> t
amp> x = <cat{c, t}, cot{o}>
x: <cat{c, t}, cot{o}>
amp> inspect x
x: #7 <c{1}, t{1}, o{1}>
amp> abab = <a -> b -> a -> b>
abab: <a, b, a, b> and transition a -> b -> a -> b
amp> aa = <abab{a, a}>
aa: <abab{a, a}>
amp> inspect aa
aa: #10 <a{2}, a{3}>
amp> ba = abab{b, a}
ba: transition abab{b, a}
amp> inspect ba
ba: #11 transition b{1} -> a{3}
amp> h, e = population 8
h: 8 members, h{1..8}, all individuals
e: 8 members, e{1..8}, all individuals
amp> thecat = <t -> h -> e -> c -> a -> t>
thecat: <t, h, e, c, a, t> and transition t -> h -> e -> c -> a -> t
amp> the = <thecat{t, h, e}>
the: <thecat{t, h, e}>
amp> inspect the
the: #14 <t{3}, h{1}, e{1}>
amp> cat2 = <thecat{c, a, t}>
cat2: <thecat{c, a, t}>
amp> inspect cat2
cat2: #15 <c{3}, a{4}, t{4}>
amp> the2 = <thecat{t -> h -> e}>
the2: <thecat{t, h, e}> and transition thecat{t, h, e}
amp> inspect the2
the2: #16 <t{3}, h{1}, e{1}>; #17 transition t{3} -> h{1} -> e{1}
amp> cat3 = thecat{c -> a -> t}
cat3: transition thecat{c, a, t}
amp> inspect cat3
cat3: #18 transition c{3} -> a{4} -> t{4}
amp> y = <thecat{t, h -> e}>
error: use commas or arrows inside braces, not both
amp> y = <abab{b, b, b}>
error: abab has no b after b
amp> y = <cat{c}>
error: an assembly needs at least two populations or parts
amp> y = <cat{z}>
error: cat has no member of z
amp> y = <c{a}>
error: c is a population, not an assembly: braces take some of an assembly's members
amp> y = <cat{1}>
error: expected a population name after "{", got 1
amp> y = <cat{}>
error: expected a population name after "{", got }
amp> y = <cat{c, a>
error: expected "," or "}" after a, got >
amp> inspect y
error: y is not declared
